# Vita

Micronutrients, decoded — evidence, not advice. A daily, source-linked ELI5 note about vitamins and mineral elements. Informational and educational only; no doses from us, no supplement sales.

## Entry points
- [Today](/): current daily note
- [Note 1 — Magnesium](/weekly/2026-11-26-magnesium/): a mineral cofactor, sourced from NIH and EFSA
- [Note 2 — Vitamin D](/weekly/2026-12-03-vitamin-d/): an organic molecule, sourced from NIH, EFSA and WHO
- [Method](/methodology/): data sources, categories, compliance, cookies
- [Archive](/archive/): all daily notes
- [RSS](/rss.xml): daily feed
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): full URL map

## Sources
NIH ODS, EFSA, WHO, Europe PMC, PubMed, Open Food Facts, USDA. Every number is a dated citation, not our advice.
